_comment: What the TonyFlix wizard installs, in order. Every third-party add-on comes from its author's own source:
repositories are fetched from the URLs below; add-ons are then installed by Kodi itself (InstallAddon) so they
keep auto-updating from their repo. TonyFlix never re-hosts anyone else's add-on.

addons.name: Trakt sync for TMDbHelper
addons._preseed_why: On a fresh box there is nothing to migrate from older TMDbHelper versions. Left to itself the module migrates on first use, and when several Home rows load at once that races and TMDbHelper shows 'Provider module unavailable'. Skipped if an older TMDbHelper Trakt sign-in exists.

accounts.name: Trakt
accounts.why: Continue Watching, Up Next and your lists
accounts._sign_out_note: TMDbHelper asks 'are you sure' itself, so TonyFlix doesn't ask again.

accounts.name: TMDb
accounts.why: Optional: your TMDb watchlist, favourites and ratings
accounts._sign_in_note: TMDbHelper asks 'use the browser?': No shows a QR code to scan with a phone.

retired._why: Removed from TonyFlix on 2026-11-14 (they were finding no sources). On boxes that already have them, the wizard DISABLES them (reversible, keeps their settings and sign-ins) and removes their TMDbHelper player files. To bring one back: Add-ons > My add-ons > enable it, and restore its player file in build/players.
